text: Hey, did anything happen around here?\nYou've been so quiet...\nWhere's the talkative Gondrum?
Ah...You got me...I'm feeling a little blue.\nThe thing is I won a lottery and I was supposed to\nmove and live here.
I enjoyed a brief moment of excitement as I\nthought I'd lead a futuristic life! But Eldenbaum\ngot occupied right before I move. I hate it!!
Darn it! How dare this thing appear again!!\nWell, I need to vent my frustration anyway!
Wowww! Perhaps the Resistles are more amazing than\nthe Technistas since they've been making airships\nthat can fly with magic like this...
Maybe one of these things could get us to Dikkit\nSector...Gondrum, please check them out.
Okay! They look seriously broken at a glance, so\ndon't get your hopes up. I think this will take a\nwhile, so you guys please go ahead.
There should be a bridge we can cross to get to\nDikkit ahead of this area. For now that's the only\nway. Let's go!
